name: Citizenship by Descent

qualifying_event.description: A person born abroad may acquire Antiguan and Barbudan citizenship where a parent or grandparent held Antiguan and Barbudan nationality at the time of independence (1 November 1981), or where a parent was in government service abroad at the time of the applicant's birth.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; documentary proof of the parent's or grandparent's nationality status at independence, or of the parent's government-service posting.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least one parent or grandparent who acquired Antiguan and Barbudan nationality at independence (1 November 1981), or a parent in government service abroad at the time of the applicant's birth.

evidence_required.document: Proof of parent's/grandparent's nationality status at independence, or of government-service posting

sources.title: Wikipedia -- Antiguan and Barbudan nationality law: citizenship by descent for persons born abroad to a parent/grandparent who was an Antiguan and Barbudan national at independence, or to a parent in government service abroad
